From The Heart

I'm sorry.

For every time I made you wait, for every word I should have said sooner, for every moment I let silence sit where softness belonged — I'm sorry.

You deserve someone who shows up fully, every single day, not just on the days that are easy. I want to be that for you, starting today and every day after.

Thank you for your patience, your softness, and for loving me even when I made it hard. Today isn't about my apology though — it's about celebrating you. But I needed you to know this, before anything else.

Agar mohabbat kisi ka naam hoti, to shayad wo tum hoti. Agar khushi ki koi wajah hoti, to shayad wo tum hoti. Aaj tumhare janamdin par bas itna kehna hai... Meri har dua ki sabse khoobsurat wajah tum ho. ❤️✨ Bas ek baar muskura do, hum phir se jeena seekh jaayein.

One Last Thing

Ready for a surprise?

Every year I get to celebrate you is a year I get to fall for you all over again. Happy Birthday, my girl. 💗

Always

“Main tujhe manane ki zid nahi karta... Bas itni si dua karta hoon, Jab bhi tujhe meri yaad aaye, Tera gussa haar jaaye aur meri mohabbat jeet jaaye.” 🥀❤️

However far apart the days may feel, you're the softest part of my life. I hope this year hands you everything you quietly hope for, and I hope you always know how deeply you're loved.

Happy Birthday. Here's to us, and to every memory still waiting to happen.

Always Yours,
Aryan ❤️
